The docs cover this, so I answered from them and didn't open any code. The recipe is in `docs/flows/add-endpoint.md`, which uses this exact feature as its example. I haven't checked the line numbers against the code.

## Worker

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `worker/src/types/index.ts` | Add `RestBody { sessionId, characterId }` next to the other `*Body` types (around `ShopTransactionBody:159`). Add a cost constant such as `INN_REST_COST`, near `XP_THRESHOLDS:175`. A flat cost is simplest. Scaling it by level is the alternative. |
| `worker/src/routes/rest.ts` (new) | Export `restRoutes = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>()` with `POST /`. It validates the body and calls `getCharacter`. It rejects with 400 if `gold < cost` or `hp >= max_hp`. Then it calls `updateCharacter(db, id, { hp: max_hp, gold: gold - cost })` (`services/character.ts:94`, which only accepts whitelisted fields). It returns `{ updatedCharacter, cost }`. Copy the structure from `routes/action.ts`. |
| `worker/src/index.ts` | Import `restRoutes` and add `app.route('/api/rest', restRoutes)` in the mount block (`:41-48`). |
| `worker/src/services/session.ts` (optional) | If you want an `appendHistory` and `saveSession` entry, or an `adventure_log` insert, so the rest shows in the log. Follow `routes/action.ts`. |

- **Combat guard (not in the docs):** the route should refuse to rest during combat. `CombatState` lives in the KV session, so read it with the session service and return 400 if combat is active. I haven't confirmed how the session service exposes this.
- **Schema:** no migration is needed, because `hp`, `max_hp` and `gold` already exist on `characters`.
- **AI:** none. The Worker owns the gold and HP math. If you want narration, call `askDM` for text only.

## Frontend

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `frontend/src/app/models/game.models.ts` | Add `RestResponse { updatedCharacter: Character; cost: number }` (near `ActionResponse:95`). Mirror any new Worker type or constant here by hand. |
| `frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.ts` | Add `rest(sessionId, characterId)` that POSTs to `${API_BASE}/api/rest` (after `shopTransaction():109`). |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts` | Add a `rest()` handler. It calls `GameApiService.rest`, then `CharacterStateService.setCharacter(res.updatedCharacter)`. It pushes a system entry such as "You rest at the inn for N gold", and reads `err.error.error` to show failures. Disable it while `inCombat()` is true. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.html` | Add a **Rest at Inn (N gp)** button next to the Inventory button (`:9`), bound to `rest()`. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.css` | Style the button if needed. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.spec.ts` | Add tests with `GameApiService` as a Jasmine spy: success updates the character, and insufficient gold shows an error. |

`CharacterStateService` needs no change. `setCharacter` already updates `hpPercent` and the sheet.

## Docs to update in the same change
- The `.md` beside each changed file, plus a new `routes/rest.md`.
- The `code.md` entry, then re-run `research-work/scripts/build-symbol-index.mjs`.
- `docs/PRD.md` §9 (API spec), `worker/src/index.md` (route mounts table) and `docs/flows/inventory.md` or a new flow doc.
